O, September 20, 1861, to serve three years; wounded at Gettysburg, Pa., July 2. 1863; appointed sergeant, date not given; re-enlisted, March 22, 1864; appointed first sergeant, May 1, 1865; mustered, out with company, at Alexandria, Va., June 27, 1865.
presence_basis: Register remark names Gettysburg: "wounded at Gettysburg, Pa., July 2. 1863"
